authority_policy: S00-S19 are a frozen project research corpus and discovery/index layer, not infallible historical authority. External primary/received/bibliographic witnesses may corroborate, refine, contradict, or expose scope/attribution defects in the project corpus. Modern software and secondary research never become historical authority by observation alone.

sources.title: 《安星法及推断实例》

sources.title: 《五行精纪》第二十八卷·起月建例
sources.quality_notes: Records the complete 五虎起月 mnemonic: 甲己丙、乙庚戊、丙辛庚、丁壬壬、戊癸甲. Used for the mechanical year-stem→寅月-stem table; not for Ziwei-specific temporal-palace semantics.

sources.title: 《中州派紫微斗数初级讲义》
sources.author: 王亭之
sources.quality_notes: Used only as a modern Zhongzhou-school witness. Public mirrors preserve the explicit leap-month half-split, flow-day forward count, and two flow-hour wordings. Bibliographic identity and table of contents are separately corroborated by the XingQiao bookstore listing.

sources.title: 《中州派紫微斗数初级讲义》
sources.author: 王亭之
sources.quality_notes: Corroborates title, author, publisher, pagination and that the volume contains 年限推断法 including 流月 and 流日流时 sections. Not a substitute for rule-text collation.

sources.title: The Equation of Time
sources.provider: U.S. Naval Observatory Astronomical Applications Department
sources.quality_notes: Defines equation of time as apparent solar time minus mean solar time, and confirms longitude dependence of local solar time. Used to audit astronomical terminology/formula only, not Ziwei doctrinal adoption.

sources.title: 《韫龄讲排盘中的时间问题》
sources.quality_notes: Explicitly distinguishes mean solar time, apparent/true solar time, longitude correction and equation of time. Modern practice evidence only; not early/classical authority.

sources.title: Chinese Text Project DataWiki · 紫微斗数 · 晚子时
sources.quality_notes: Explicitly records two late-Zi date-attribution methods and says next-day treatment is currently mainstream. This is community/modern evidence only, not a primary historical text.

sources.title: 《子时出生的命：是否要区分早子时、晚子时？》
sources.author: 令东来
sources.provider: 东来紫微 / 玄门信息咨询
sources.quality_notes: Reports practical use of both late-Zi treatments and recommends parallel charts in disputed cases. Modern practice only; not classical authority.

sources.title: The 24 Solar Terms
sources.quality_notes: Defines the 24 terms as 15° ecliptic-longitude divisions and lists Spring Commences at 315°, Insects Waken at 345°, etc. Used for modern astronomical realization only, not Bazi doctrinal authority.

sources.title: Date and Time of the 24 Solar Terms
sources.quality_notes: HKO states its solar-term timing data are based on HM Nautical Almanac Office and USNO astronomical data. Used as an external timing oracle, not as a metaphysical rule source.

sources.title: 《三命通会》卷二《论四时节气》及月令段
sources.author: 万民英
sources.quality_notes: Binds 正月寅 to 立春/雨水, 二月卯 to 惊蛰/春分, etc., and discusses 交气/节气 semantics. Supports the Bazi month-season framework; it is not used to claim modern ephemeris precision.

sources.title: 《命理探源》卷二《起例》推年法、推月法
sources.author: 袁树珊
sources.historical_period: 民国早期 later explicit witness
sources.quality_notes: Gives explicit before/after-Lichun examples for the year pillar and before/after-Jie examples for the month pillar, including same-day hour-level boundary cases. Later witness; never back-dated.

sources.title: 《千里命稿》立春推年例
sources.quality_notes: Explicitly states 推年以立春为标准 and gives before/after-boundary examples. Used as later corroboration.

sources.title: 《千里命稿》大运部位起点问答
sources.quality_notes: Explicitly states Dayun starts from the natal month pillar as the base; forward first formal Dayun is the next sexagenary pillar, reverse first formal Dayun is the previous pillar, with complete example sequences. Later witness; not back-dated.

sources.title: 《命理探源》卷二起大运法
sources.author: 袁树珊
sources.historical_period: 民国早期 later explicit witness
sources.quality_notes: Worked examples say 起运从生月顺布/逆布 and list the first formal luck pillar as the adjacent sexagenary pillar, independently corroborating the sequence.

sources.title: 《三命通会》卷二《论大运》
sources.author: 万民英
sources.quality_notes: Preserves 阳男阴女顺/阴男阳女逆, Jie-based interval calculation, one-辰-ten-year structure, real elapsed day/hour counting, explicit small-month and leap-month corrections, and the statement that after the first handover the next luck frame changes after ten anniversaries. This supports a classical lunisolar calendarized schedule family but does not license substituting a modern Gregorian or UTC calendar.

sources.title: 《三命通会》卷二·六合/三合/三刑/六害关系段
sources.author: 万民英
sources.quality_notes: Used to corroborate branch harmony/trine/punishment/harm geometry. Its 无恩/恃势 naming of the two three-punishment cycles conflicts with the S14 frozen YHZP transcription while the directed pair geometry agrees; names are therefore not silently normalized.

sources.title: 《御定星历考原》卷一·五合/支合/三合
sources.quality_notes: Corroborates five stem-combination pairs and elements, six branch-harmony pairs, and the four standard three-combination bureaus. Later witness only.

sources.title: 《三命通会》卷一·辰戌丑未土局用语见证
sources.author: 万民英
sources.quality_notes: Contains the explicit expression 辰戌丑未土局. Used together with the frozen S14 YHZP chapter 8 transcription, which lists 辰戌丑未土局 in the relation table. This is a four-member bureau candidate and must not be coerced into the three-member BRANCH_TRINE type.

sources.title: 《三命通会》卷六《属象》
sources.author: 万民英
sources.quality_notes: Explicitly groups 寅卯辰 as eastern Wood, 巳午未 as southern Fire, 申酉戌 as western Metal, and 亥子丑 as northern Water. The text uses 属象/一方之气 rather than the modern label 三会; the audit records an explicit philological bridge over the same mechanical membership/direction geometry.

sources.title: 《五行精纪》第二十三卷《破杀》
sources.quality_notes: Cites 《李虚中书》 and lists 卯午、丑辰、子酉、未戌 as 相破, explicitly stating 寅申巳亥无破 because those branches pair by 合. This conflicts with later six-break tables that add 寅亥 and 巳申.

sources.title: 《三命通会》卷二·座下自化
sources.author: 万民英
sources.quality_notes: Lists 壬午、丁亥、戊子、甲午、辛巳、癸巳 under 座下自化. Later 《命理探源》 explicitly glosses this family as 干支暗合. Mechanical audit treats the occurrence as a same-pillar visible-stem ↔ hidden-stem five-combination candidate, without asserting successful transformation.

sources.title: OpenFate Wiki · 三合缺一字 / 半合 / 拱合
sources.quality_notes: Documents modern distinctions among complete trine, center-containing half-trine and outer-pair arched trine. Modern reference only; historical authority remains insufficient. It is cited to describe current terminology, not to back-date the method.

sources.title: 《命理探源》卷五《化合刑冲》
sources.author: 袁树珊
sources.historical_period: 民国早期 later explicit witness
sources.quality_notes: Explicitly describes 座下自化 as 干支暗合 and repeats 壬午、丁亥、戊子、甲午、辛巳、癸巳. Registered separately from the repository's Night-Zi chapter source ID so source scope is not conflated.

sources.title: 《子平真诠评注》卷内《论杂气如何取用》
sources.author: 沈孝瞻原著；后世评注本
sources.historical_period: 清原著传统 / 后世评注传本
sources.quality_notes: The received passage says 辰本藏戊 and separately identifies water storage and 乙余气. It supports a later main-qi-first conceptual distinction for 辰, but it is not a complete twelve-branch 本/中/余 ordered table and must not be used to back-fill exact ordinals for every branch.

sources.title: 《五行精纪》第卅三卷《论大运》
sources.quality_notes: Preserves 一辰十岁、三日为年, requires 实历过日时, gives the five-days-three-shichen example, and rejects rough integer-year approximation. It closes the discrete day/shichen ratio family but does not define a modern second-level or Gregorian realization.

sources.title: 《明史·历志》大统历法
sources.historical_period: 清修明史，记明代历法制度
sources.quality_notes: Qing-compiled dynastic-history witness for Ming Datong context. Vol.35 received text gives a different conjunction-correction denominator: 迟疾限行度 minus 820 (定限度). Batch 11F treats this as a later received textual variant because the 1569 Ming facsimile, a Ming-authorial Datong worked example, and surviving official-almanac timings converge on D1. Retain for transmission history, not as the production-method winner.

sources.title: 《新历晓惑》 / Xin li xiao huo
sources.historical_period: 清；馆藏说明追述1645新历颁行
sources.quality_notes: Library of Congress description records the 1645 adoption of a new calendar based on the earlier reform program and notes differences from older Chinese calendrical calculations. Used only to establish a post-Ming regime boundary, not as a Ming calendar algorithm.

sources.title: 《大明大統曆法》
sources.author: 周相
sources.edition: 日本國立公文書館內閣文庫藏明隆慶刊本之公開影像
sources.provider: Kotenmon digitized facsimile / Japan National Archives Cabinet Library witness
sources.quality_notes: Facsimile directly preserves the Ming-period method witness. The first computational volume is headed 步氣朔; pages 8–12 preserve epoch/constants and qishuo procedure headings, page 24 preserves迟疾差 interpolation, and page 32's 推加减差分法 directly divides the combined correction by the corresponding 太阴迟/疾行度. This is direct primary-facsimile support for the D1/Shoushi-style conjunction denominator. Use page-image collation for every glyph-critical transcription. Batch 11G also collates zero-based PDF page 41, where the primary facsimile directly gives 推合朔時刻法: 定朔小餘 is converted through the 12-shichen / 100-ke historical clock, counted from 子正, with half-shichen 子初 labeling.

sources.title: 《大明萬曆六年歲次戊寅大統曆》
sources.catalog_identifier: 國家圖書館書號/登錄號 06313
sources.provider: 臺灣國家圖書館古籍與特藏文獻資源
sources.quality_notes: NCL catalog identifies the exact 1578 one-volume Ming Qintianjian printed almanac (book no. 06313) and records the Qintianjian calendar seal. A public 28-page scan is now located through the Wikimedia Commons NCL backup. Eleven of twelve consecutive month-calendar pages have been directly rendered and their month identities/large-small labels agree with the official-record oracle and D1 replay; the month-6 PDF page repeatedly failed the session screenshot renderer, so complete 12/12 physical page collation is deliberately not claimed. The physical month grid is day-level evidence and is not treated as exact true-conjunction-time or meridian certification.

sources.title: 《明大統曆法彙編》簡介
sources.author: 中國科學院自然科學史研究所（李亮整理成果介紹）
sources.provider: 中國科學院自然科學史研究所
sources.quality_notes: Explicitly warns that the later 《明史·曆志》 Datong material differs materially from Ming official Datong works and that some algorithms/tables were later altered or recompiled. Identifies Zhou Xiang's Ming Longqing 《大明大統曆法》 and Yuan Tong's 《大統曆法通軌》 among the primary Ming witnesses used in the critical compilation.

sources.title: 《國家圖書館藏明代大統曆日彙編》（全六冊）
sources.historical_period: 明代官頒曆書影印彙編；modern facsimile publication 2007
sources.quality_notes: Publisher states the six-volume set contains 99 Ming Datong almanacs (105 fascicles), all Ming printed editions, from 1446 to 1641. Its table of contents includes nearby Longqing/Wanli years such as 1569, 1577, 1579 and 1581; the listed series does not include 1578, so the NCL 1578 witness remains the same-year oracle target.

sources.title: 《明神宗顯皇帝實錄》萬曆六年卷七十一至八十二及萬曆七年卷八十三月朔鏈
sources.historical_period: 明代官方實錄傳統；萬曆朝記事的後續官修編纂見證
sources.quality_notes: Volumes 71–82 preserve the first-day Ganzhi of months 1–12 of Wanli 6; volume 83 preserves the next year's first-month start, allowing every 29/30-day transition and the 354-day year total to be replayed. Volume 80 also records the Qintianjian presentation and empire-wide promulgation of the following year's Datong almanac. This is a high-quality official-record corroboration oracle, not the same physical 1578 almanac and not by itself a general Datong arithmetic specification.

sources.title: 《萬曆起居注》萬曆六年月朔及月內日期記錄
sources.historical_period: 明萬曆六年記事；public digital transcription
sources.quality_notes: Corroborates multiple Wanli 6 month-start Ganzhi and provides within-month dated entries that independently reproduce several month starts. Used as a second textual check only; the public transcription is not treated as an edition-critical facsimile or as a complete replacement for the official almanac.

sources.title: 《古今律历考》卷四十九·万历二十四年丙申岁闰八月朔日食历〈大统〉
sources.author: 邢云路
sources.historical_period: 明；卷中实例标万历二十四年（1596）
sources.quality_notes: The worked example is explicitly labeled 大统. At 求加减差 it multiplies the residual correction by 820 and divides by 迟行度, then obtains 加差 and 定朔. This independently agrees with the 1569 Zhou Xiang facsimile's D1 denominator. Because the digital witness is a later Siku recension, it corroborates Ming authorial practice but does not supersede the primary Ming facsimile. The same worked example converts 定朔 small remainder by 發斂法 (1分20秒 multiplier shorthand) and explicitly obtains 乙丑日午正初刻, providing a deterministic time-coordinate replay case.

sources.title: 《明嘉靖六年〈大统历〉历书的气朔推步精度》
sources.author: 李勇
sources.provider: 中国科学院上海天文台《天文学进展》
sources.quality_notes: Peer-reviewed reconstruction of the 1527 Datong almanac's qishuo computation. Used to test recoverability and accuracy of historical algorithms and to locate D1/D2 issues; never substitutes for Ming primary wording or official-almanac page evidence.

sources.title: 《明朝〈大统历〉的定朔计算及历表朔日订正》
sources.author: Yuk Tung Liu
sources.publication_date: 2019-08 initial draft; living web research page
sources.quality_notes: Compares D1=迟疾限行度 and D2=定限度 against 56 conjunction-time entries in six surviving Ming Datong almanacs (1531, 1532, 1604, 1616, 1629, 1639). Reports all 56 D1 results within printed time bins, while most D2 results fall outside and one near-midnight case moves the conjunction day. Validation evidence only; historical method identity is anchored by primary/received Ming witnesses.

sources.title: 《中国古历定朔推步综述》
sources.author: 李勇、张培瑜
sources.provider: 中国科学院上海天文台《天文学进展》
sources.quality_notes: Systematic review of ancient Chinese real-new-moon calculation, including Shoushi-family methods. Used for mathematical/genealogical background and terminology; primary Ming method adjudication remains edition- and oracle-scoped.

sources.title: Chinese syzygy calculation established in the 13th century
sources.author: Y. Li and C. Z. Zhang
sources.quality_notes: International peer-reviewed mathematical reconstruction of the Shoushi syzygy model. Used as cross-language scholarship for model structure and historical astronomy context; not a Ming textual authority.

sources.title: 《明史》卷三十五《大統曆法三上·步氣朔發斂附》
sources.historical_period: 清修《明史》received text recording Ming Datong procedure
sources.quality_notes: Records 日周一萬=一百刻, decimal subunits below ke, and 推發斂加時: multiply event small remainder by 12, count full 10000 units from 子正, handle half-shichen 子初, and derive ke. Used as received corroboration of the 1569 primary facsimile, not to override it.

sources.title: 《明史·天文志》北京/南京觀象臺、漏刻與日出入時刻差異
sources.historical_period: 清修明史，記明代觀測制度
sources.quality_notes: Records that Beijing polar altitude and sunrise/sunset times differ from Nanjing and that old Nanjing clepsydra forms were unsuitable in Beijing. This proves geographic clock dependence but does not by itself identify the meridian reference of every Datong conjunction calculation.

sources.title: 《萬曆野獲編》卷二十《釐正曆法》
sources.author: 沈德符
sources.historical_period: 明末筆記，追記正統/景泰大統曆晝夜時刻改議
sources.quality_notes: Preserves the debate over replacing Nanjing daylength values with Beijing observations and the subsequent reversion. Useful for regime/scope history; not direct evidence that qishuo/conjunction small remainder used the same geographic reference.

sources.title: Analysis of interval constants of Shoushili-affiliated calendars
sources.author: Byeong-Hee Mihn; Ki-Won Lee; Young Sook Ahn
sources.quality_notes: Compares Shoushi/Datong-affiliated interval constants and modern astronomical results; independently verifies that Shoushi-Licheng sunrise/sunset data correspond to Beijing while Mingshi Datong sunrise/sunset data correspond to Nanjing. This validates geographic scope for those tables, not automatically for conjunction meridian reference.

sources.title: Investigating Chinese mathematical techniques to calculate sunrise and sunset times in Datongli
sources.author: G.-E. Choi; K.-W. Lee; B.-H. Mihn; L. Li; Y.-H. Ryu; Y. S. Ahn
sources.quality_notes: Reconstructs Datongli sunrise/sunset calculations and checks Mingshi tables, providing independent cross-language validation of the location-dependent clock/daylength subsystem. Not a primary historical source.

sources.title: 《大明嘉靖三年歲次甲申大統曆》
sources.edition: 明刻本；欽天監頒行系統
sources.provider: Library of Congress Chinese Rare Book Collection
sources.quality_notes: Library of Congress provides 37 digitized images and records the Qintianjian anti-counterfeit promulgation notice. Added to broaden official-almanac oracle coverage outside Chinese/Taiwanese holdings; page-level qishuo/time extraction remains future work.

sources.title: 《交食推步法》
sources.author: 李純之、金石悌奉命編
sources.historical_period: 朝鮮世祖四年／天順二年（1458）
sources.edition: 古活字本（大字丙辰字、中字甲寅字）
sources.quality_notes: Kyujanggak catalogs the 1458 Korean edition. Its preface says the method was developed from Shoushi/Datong materials for Joseon use, explicitly criticizes direct use of Chinese Datong sunrise/sunset values at Hanyang, and states that several difference/correction procedures were recast to compute directly without the original licheng tables. Its chiji interpolation divides by 820.08 and its dingxian-line-speed path subtracts 8.2008, so it is a valuable cross-regional algorithm-divergence witness but must not be used to overwrite the 1569 Zhou Xiang Ming D1 method.

sources.title: 《高麗史》卷五十二·授時曆立成·太陰限數遲疾度
sources.historical_period: 朝鮮王朝官修《高麗史》；1451成書，保存高麗受授時曆資料
sources.quality_notes: Digital transcription of the Goryeosa/Shoushi received tradition and useful as a second digital presentation, but not automatically an independent physical-edition witness. It agrees with KRDB o on several divergences from the Ming 1569 primary, including solar D16, lunar L8, L124 and L132; it aligns with Ming and KRDB r normalization on L114. Compact Han numeric surfaces such as L101 are parsed with positional awareness and are not treated as decimal digit strings. Direct physical-image comparison remains required for edition-level causal claims.

sources.title: 梅文鼎《歷算全書》卷二十一《曆學駢枝》
sources.author: 梅文鼎
sources.quality_notes: Explains the table semantics explicitly: limits 1–83 use 益, limits 84–168 use 損; row residual is multiplied by 損益分 and divided by 820. Used to explain and test the primary 1569 table, never to supersede it.

sources.title: 梅文鼎《大統曆志》卷四
